note:
The placement test behind the “I don't know” tile on the homepage (src/pages/placement-test.astro). The A1 set is also the quick check on /step-by-step.

Six items per level; the test draws two, so someone who takes it twice does not get the same sentences. Each item tests exactly one feature that is typical of its level and not yet expected at the level below: être and avoir, the -er present, le/la, ne…pas, est-ce que and adjective agreement for A1; the passé composé with avoir (irregular participle) and with être, the imparfait, direct object pronouns, the futur proche and the partitive for A2; passé composé against imparfait, the subjunctive after a wish, en, dont, the conditional and the future after quand for B1; si + imparfait, bien que + subjunctive, the passive, backshift in reported speech, past participle agreement with a preceding direct object and the gérondif for B2; the past subjunctive, cleft sentences with a preposition (C'est à… que), à condition que, comme si + imparfait, nominalisation and the journalistic conditional for C1.

The standard is the French of France, traditional spelling. Only one option is right, and the wrong ones are the mistakes learners really make at that point (écrivé, je parlerai for je parlerais, the present after quand for a future event, Si nous aurions, C'est à Lucie à qui). A test you can pass by ruling out the silly answer measures nothing. Options that a native speaker could also accept in some context are left out: sonnait next to a sonné (hence soudain), the plus-que-parfait next to the passé composé (étions allés), aura fait for the journalistic conditional, doit/devra in a news sentence, viendra in reported speech with le lendemain. Spoken forms that drop ne or the agreement of the participle are never the right answer; the written standard is tested.

Items on things that differ in Québec (the health card, the préfecture) carry a frCA note (docs/content-plan.md §1.5); the page ignores the field for now. Prompts keep a non-breaking space before ? ! : ; (§1.2); options and answers never hold one.

Item order is part of the problem-report ref (x:einstufung/<level>/q<n>).

A1.prompt: Nous ___ un rendez-vous à la mairie.

frCA.note: In Québec the health card is the carte d'assurance maladie (RAMQ), not the carte Vitale.
frCA.form: ___ vous avez votre carte d'assurance maladie ?

frCA.note: Canada has no préfecture: immigration files go to IRCC, and in Québec also to the MIFI.
frCA.form: Mon dossier ___ par IRCC la semaine dernière.

B2.prompt: Karim m'a dit qu'il ___ le lendemain.
